login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Use the email and password for your owner account.
login.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
login.lockedFor: Too many wrong tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts from here. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.

mfa.lead: One more step. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.hint: Lost your phone? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.

setup.lead: Your account now needs a second step at sign-in: a code from an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.
setup.title: Set up your authenticator app
setup.onPhone: On the phone that has your authenticator app, open this link:
setup.openApp: Add Crew Stars to my authenticator app
setup.typeKey: Or add an account in the app by hand and type this key:
setup.enterCode: Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows below.
setup.hint: The code changes every 30 seconds. Any current one works.

recovery.lead: Two-step sign-in is on. Keep these codes somewhere safe, away from your phone: each one signs you in once if you lose it. They won't be shown again.
recovery.title: Save your recovery codes

comingSoon.title: Arrives in phase {phase}
comingSoon.lead: Sign-in, navigation and this page's frame are ready. The data and controls for it come with that phase.

overview.title: Hi {name}, here's {month}
overview.lead: Recognition across your stores this month. Pick a store to drill in.

recognize.title: Recognize anyone
recognize.lead: Owners can recognize directors, supervisors, GMs and crew directly. Filter by role or store instead of scrolling through everyone.

people.title: Stores & people
people.lead: Everyone in the program, store by store.

redemptions.title: Redemptions
redemptions.lead: Every reward request across your stores. GMs approve these in their app; you can step in here too.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.lead: What crew can spend their coins on, what each costs, and which tier or badge unlocks it.

coins.title: Coins & limits
coins.lead: How many coins people can give, who they can give them to, and how much they can redeem.

spin.title: Spin the wheel
spin.lead: When crew earn a spin, how many they can get, and what's on the wheel. Spins are always earned, never bought.

badges.title: Badges & tiers
badges.lead: Tiers go up with coins earned all time and never reset. Badges reward specific things. Both can unlock rewards.

awards.title: Monthly awards
awards.lead: Award categories each store competes in, and the coins each winner gets. Winners are picked from the month's numbers.

roster.title: Roster
roster.lead: The people, stores and areas in the program. Add someone, import a CSV, or end someone's access.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Every change to rules, rewards, approvals and the roster: who made it, when, and what it was before.

notFound.title: We can't find that page
notFound.lead: The link may be old, or the page may have moved.

import.heading: Import people from a CSV
import.lead: Export the roster from payroll or HR, check what it would change, then import it. Nothing changes until you press Import.
import.ruleColumns: Columns: eid, name and role are required; store, stores, area, phone, hire_date and language are optional.
import.rulePlacement: Crew, shift managers and GMs need a store number. Supervisors need stores (numbers separated by ;). Directors need an area name.
import.ruleUpdate: Someone whose Employee ID is already on the roster is updated. An empty cell keeps what the roster has.
import.ruleNever: Excel files and columns such as SSN, birth date or address are refused: Crew Stars never keeps them.
import.fileHint: A .csv file saved from Excel, Google Sheets or your payroll system.
import.commit: Import {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
import.counts: {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} read: {create} to add, {update} to update, {error} with problems.
import.skipped: Lines with problems are skipped. Fix them in the file and import it again to bring them in.
import.caption: Lines in the file
import.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} lines. The counts above cover the whole file.
import.csv_too_big: That file is too big. Split it into files of up to 5,000 people.
import.csv_unreadable: That file couldn't be read. Save it as CSV and choose it again.
